listener.cutover_note: 192.0.2.1 only while an approved Capstone migration is open; never in the default rule
listener.local_loopback: not bound; health checks on the hub use https://192.0.2.254:8443 with the CA

outbound.purpose: Ollama on approved heads, plain HTTP on the isolated lab LAN

outbound_note: No other outbound connection: no internet, DNS, NTP client role beyond the hub's own Windows time service, or package download

tls.issuer: Gateway lab CA created by scripts/New-GatewayCertificate.ps1 (ECDSA P-384, 5 years); no public CA
tls.ca_private_key: C:\ProgramData\InferenceGateway\ca\ca.key (SYSTEM and Administrators only; move offline after issuance)
tls.renewal: deploy certificate --renew, then restart the service; clients keep the same CA
tls.ca_distribution: inference-gateway-ca.pem is public and may travel on F:; clients name it in ca_file
tls.key_acl: SYSTEM and Administrators full, service account read; Arena and Users none

service.name: InferenceGateway
service.supervisor: Windows Service Control Manager (native host, ctypes; no wrapper)
service.pre_stop: admission drain (persistent, reopened only at the service's own next start), up to 90 s for active allocations
service.logs: C:\ProgramData\InferenceGateway\logs\gateway-service.log (10 MiB x 10, JSON lines, no prompts/outputs/tokens)
service.observation_publisher: in-service thread, 5 s; Task Scheduler alternative retained but not used by default

service_account.name: svc-inference-gw
service_account.groups: Users only; never Administrators or Backup Operators
service_account.password: operator-typed when F: creates the account and again at install (stdin); never stored, logged or put on a command line

arena_accounts.rule: every Windows account that owns an Arena process reading the observation (admin window, admin console, event service)
requirements: not a transitive member of Administrators or Backup Operators

runtime.install: official python-3.12.10-amd64.exe /quiet InstallAllUsers=1 TargetDir="C:\Program Files\Python312" PrependPath=0 Include_launcher=0 Include_test=0
runtime.offline_installer_note: Not shipped: F: supplies the official installer and verifies python.org's published hash
runtime.virtual_environment_note: A venv python.exe is a redirector whose child cannot connect to the SCM; the base interpreter runs an isolated release folder
runtime.powershell: PowerShell 7.4 or later, machine-wide (certificate issuance and ACL scripts)

commands.credentials_temporary: service_launcher.py credentials reissue --database <ledger> --app-id <app> --policy <clients-only policy> --output <token file> | credentials grant-heads --database <ledger> --app-id <app> --like <template app> | credentials withdraw-heads --database <ledger> --app-id <app>

results: every command prints one JSON object with ok; exit 0 success, 1 a failed check or refused step, 2 bad input
order: F: inbound firewall rule from listener.firewall_rule

head_inventory_input.accepted: heads[]: resource_id == arena_node_id == head-192-0-2-N, address 192.0.2.N (2-199, never .254), endpoint http://192.0.2.N:11434, verified.ollama_version present
head_inventory_input.effect: writes a reviewable policy; nothing is enrolled until bootstrap, nothing is usable until qualification

capstone.acl: SYSTEM and Administrators full, LOCAL SERVICE read

tokens.environment_variables: none: CAPSTONE_INFERENCE_TOKEN, CAPSTONE_INFRASTRUCTURE_TOKEN and APPLICATION_INFERENCE_TOKEN are not used in gateway deployments; token_file wins in the SDK

head_transport.decision: plain HTTP to http://192.0.2.N:11434 from 192.0.2.254 only, enforced by each head's firewall
head_transport.mtls_proxy: not adopted in 0.4.x; supported later without code change (https endpoint plus upstream_tls), with requalification

health_checks.ready_semantics: 200 when the ledger is usable and admission is open; 503 when drained or stopping

open_items.item: Approve the lab LAN for the data classes sent over plain HTTP to heads, or require the mTLS head proxy
Whether 192.0.2.1 is allowed during cutover, and its end date
Arena standard account name(s) on the hub; Arena moves off the administrative account
Capstone reads gateway-client.json with token_file; retire the three token variable names
Coder client adoption and its approved models
Each head's slots (= its OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL) and memory_gb (GiB models may occupy) in the policy
Verify on Ollama 0.40.13 heads: HTTP codes per failure, and that /api/ps lists a busy runner past its expires_at (measured here on 0.40.16)
The gemma3:270m error text of 2026-11-11 (capacity_invocations.error): 4xx or 5xx decides request fault or model-on-head
open_items.resolution: HTTP 400 (request fault): fails the request only since 0.4.0

classes.request_fault: HTTP 4xx or ClientPolicyError: the request fails; head and model untouched
classes.model_on_head: HTTP 5xx or an invalid reply: that model suspended on that head for that operation; request re-placed once
classes.head_unreachable: no connection before the request was sent: head offline until its heartbeat returns; request re-placed once
classes.uncertain_execution: timeout/reset/truncation after sending, or an executing lease expiring: whole head held; never replayed

failure_recovery.cascade: same model+digest+operation on 2 heads within 600 s: suspended on every head
failure_recovery.safe_to_probe: held head: deadline passed, /api/version answers, two /api/ps reads 2 s apart list no loaded model
failure_recovery.configured_in: operator policy blocks failure_policy and placement_policy (bootstrap); per-head slots, memory_gb and (0.4.4) model_capacity in resources[]

order: model loaded (fresh /api/ps) or in use: fewest leases, least recently assigned
fits in free memory without unloading: most free memory, least recently assigned
may unload idle models only: fewest leases, least recently assigned
never: a head with no free slot
a load that would unload a model an active lease uses
placement.stale: loaded unknown: only a head whose active leases all use the same model (or none)

upgrade.verb: update (run from the 0.4.6 package); ledger kept, same ledger_id; the service restarts once as part of update
upgrade.ledger: additive only: index capacity_qualification_evidence_resource and table capacity_upstream_errors (0.4.6, created at first start); 0.4.4 indexes and capacity_model_capacity; 0.4.3 capacity_inventory_runtime.families; older releases ignore them
upgrade.configuration: no new or changed keys: gateway-service.json, deployment settings, the bootstrap policy (model_capacity, placement_policy.unmeasured_model_limit, failure_policy) and credentials are kept as they are; do not re-run bootstrap or credentials for the update
upgrade.heads: no head state changes. After a head's Ollama upgrade: requalify, then declare (Arena model_capacity) or measure (qualify --parallel N) per model before it runs more than one call of a serial-family model. Optional (0.4.6): qualify --purpose structured_chat for models whose roles send chat with a JSON schema
upgrade.from_0_4_4: as 0.4.5: placement_policy.unmeasured_model_limit defaults to 0 until the bootstrap sets it
upgrade.from_0_4_1_or_0_4_2: as 0.4.3: column capacity_inventory_runtime.families; requalify completion for reasoning models that failed under 0.4.1 (deepseek-r1)
upgrade.from_0_4_0: as 0.4.1: table capacity_request_times, WAL journal; requalify pairs 0.4.0 removed
upgrade.from_0_3_0: as 0.4.0: quarantined heads become held heads; listed in held_at_upgrade
upgrade.rollback: supported to 0.4.5, 0.4.4, 0.4.3, 0.4.2, 0.4.1, 0.4.0 and 0.3.0 (0.4.6 upstream error rows and structured_chat evidence are then ignored; declared and measured model capacity is ignored before 0.4.4)

client_library.note: 0.4.2 (with Gateway 0.4.6) adds gateway_info(), policy(availability=False), fleet() and fleet_cached(); every 0.4.1 call and its retry behaviour is unchanged; works with Gateway 0.2.0 and later (new calls fall back or raise GatewayFeatureUnavailable on older Gateways)

lab_tools.run_on: the hub, by the operator, while the Gateway is idle (the .cmd asks for administrator rights)
lab_tools.identity: G6 and the launch storm issue a temporary lab-capacity-check identity with credentials reissue / grant-heads (qwen3.5:4b and qwen3:4b, max 24, queue 24, priority 0 and no priority aging, the heads of capstone-research, expiring after the planned run plus a margin) and revoke it (credentials revoke, withdraw-heads) when they end; the temporary verbs act only on lab- identities the Gateway issued as temporary; token in C:\ProgramData\AgentArenaLab\lab-capacity-check (owner and ACL verified), deleted afterwards; --cleanup removes an interrupted run; needs Gateway 0.4.6
lab_tools.changes: no capacity, model_capacity, placement or failure policy, qualification, installed model or other client; one disabled lab-capacity-check client row stays as history; results beside each tool
